blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. This is a happy way to learn. Go with a smile.

Accounting is the language of numbers at Czarnikow. Today we study Daily Expenses. You learn short, useful sentences for the finance team.

You learn five new words today. We use them in short, simple sentences. Go slowly. One step at a time. You can do it!

items.q: What is today's lesson about?
items.why: "Today we study Daily Expenses."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "You learn five new words today."

items.q: At Czarnikow, accounting is the language of…
items.why: "Accounting is the language of numbers at Czarnikow."

items.q: "Go slowly. One step at a time." This suggests the writer wants you to…
items.why: Inferência: pedir para ir devagar mostra que o autor quer que você fique calmo, sem pressa.

items.q: How would you best describe the writer's tone?
items.why: Inferência: "This is a happy way to learn" e "You can do it!" mostram um tom gentil e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentar o tema para uma nova trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, and welcome to the team. My name is Sophie. I work in accounting here at Czarnikow. I am very happy to meet you today.

Today we learn about daily expenses. Daily expenses are small costs. We pay them every day. They are not big, but they are important. Let me show you five words. Please say them with me. Repetition is good.

First, coffee. We buy coffee in the morning. Second, taxi. Sometimes we take a taxi to a meeting. Third, lunch. We eat lunch at one o'clock. Fourth, supplies. Supplies are pens, paper, and small things for the office. Fifth, ticket. A ticket is for the train or the bus.

Every day, I write these costs in the computer. The numbers must be correct. Every coffee, every taxi, every ticket. This is very important in accounting. We are a small team, but we are careful.

Do not worry. This is easy. We go step by step, one word at a time. If you have a question, please ask me. I am always here to help you. Let's start now.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Sophie's job?
items.why: "I work in accounting here at Czarnikow."

items.q: What are the five words about?
items.why: "Today we learn about daily expenses… Let me show you five words."

items.q: When do they eat lunch?
items.why: "Third, lunch. We eat lunch at one o'clock."

items.q: Why does Sophie say "Say them with me"?
options: She wants to end the lesson
She wants the trainee to practise the words
She is talking on the phone
items.why: Inferência: pedir para repetir junto mostra que ela quer que a trainee pratique as palavras.

items.q: How would you describe Sophie with the new trainee?
items.why: Inferência: "Do not worry", "I am always here to help you" mostram um jeito amigável e prestativo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We buy coffee every morning at the office." Coffee is…
items.why: Coffee = café, uma bebida quente.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I take a ___ to the airport because it is fast."
items.why: Taxi = táxi, o carro que você pega para ir a algum lugar.

items.q: "We eat lunch at one o'clock." Lunch is…
options: the meal in the middle of the day
items.why: Lunch = almoço, a refeição do meio do dia.

items.q: "Supplies are pens, paper, and small things for the office." Supplies means…
items.why: Supplies = suprimentos, os materiais do escritório.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I buy a train ___ to go to the meeting in São Paulo."
items.why: Ticket = bilhete / passagem, para o trem ou o ônibus.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho de contabilidade. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please hand in your receipts to me." Hand in means to…
items.why: Hand in = entregar algo à pessoa certa.

items.q: "The manager must sign off on the report." Sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Good. The numbers add up." Add up means…
items.why: Add up = as contas batem, o total está correto.

items.q: "Please fill out this expense form." Fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher com as informações.

items.q: "We keep track of our daily expenses." Keep track of means to…
items.why: Keep track of = acompanhar e registrar com cuidado.
